claims.harm: Logging all required transactions in non-test settings could cause log rate-limiting
claims.quote: Could this cause log rate-limiting? Maybe a good use for the trace log level?
claims.settled_by_quote: Trace and Debug level logs are not rate limited

claims.harm: Seeding prefill candidates with the coinbase forces unnecessary TCP syscalls and prefill branch execution even when no extra transactions are prefilled
claims.quote: In that case, the check in net_processing for prefill_candidates.size() > 0 is always true, so we will always go through the prefill path and do all the syscalls even for the current behavior of always prefilling only the coinbase.
claims.settled_by_quote: Great catch, thank you, I took this by changing the check to be prefill_candidates.size() > 1

claims.harm: Use-after-free by resetting txn_available before retrieving its size
claims.quote: This is a use-after-free. We need to get the size before we reset it 3 lines above.
claims.settled_by_quote: Thanks for catching, sorry the quality of this logging commit was low when I pushed it.

claims.harm: prefilled_size is never incremented, resulting in inaccurate reconstruction log stats
claims.quote: the value is always zero. Which could not be true in any scenario as coinbase is always prefilled. I couldn't find any assignment to it, probably it's a simple fix.
claims.settled_by_quote: Thanks, I've rebased this on #35724, so marking as resolved.
